item.title: 3.0.0-beta.7
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 126

This beta has everything from alpha.13 and alpha.14, and the fixes made since. Scripts, Triggers and Widgets become modules you can switch on and off, Settings is rebuilt on ThawUI, Layout gets a pop-out window and undo for every edit, and search becomes Floe's launcher. Your settings, triggers, scripts and widget design carry over.

Thaw 3 is now feature frozen: no new features before 3.0, only finishing the ones already here, like Pop Out Editor. From here on, betas only get fixes for bugs that get in your way, and smaller fixes ship in the alphas. See you in Vice City.

Tip

If you'd like to help, #1529 lists work that's ready to pick up. Some of it needs no Swift at all.

New

  • Pop Out Editor (work in progress). Opens Layout in a window with every item in a list, a filter, an editor for the selected item and full keyboard control.
  • Every Layout edit can be undone with ⌘Z, including moving a group, Move to and Move All.
  • Drag down the Layout window's checkboxes to show or hide several items at once.
  • Trackpad taps for Layout and sliders, when a drag crosses a section or lands and when a slider reaches its default.
  • The current Space in the menu bar, in Displays › Spaces.
  • Layout warns when items don't fit or macOS hides Focus, with a one-click fix for each. Reported by @JosefGvirt in #1477.
  • The widget icon shows real readings and Bluetooth audio, in a larger size. Suggested by @joaofrgomes in #1378.
  • Thaw 2 settings are back: Always Hidden only, inline notch overflow, Settings without a Dock icon, and log size and retention.
  • Settings that only worked through links have rows in Visibility and Layout.
  • Export Logs zips logs and capture samples for a bug report, in Troubleshooting.
  • Privacy shows the Notifications permission.
  • Displays lists displays that aren't connected, and can forget them.
  • Hold Option on Capture Hidden Items to retake every picture.
  • Release notes can stay closed after an update, in Privacy.
  • Modules. Settings › Modules switches Scripts, Triggers and Widgets on and off, and a module that's off doesn't run.

Changed

  • Search is rebuilt as Floe's launcher, grouped by section in an Extended or Compact layout, and it takes its look from your menu bar.
  • Settings search goes to the row and finds each module's switch.
  • Segmented choices and the tabs in Settings are the system's own control. The selection is a glass lens you can press and drag across the choices.
  • The Thaw Bar has its own switch again, and so does double-clicking Thaw's icon for Always Hidden. By @malash in #1339.
  • Apply to All Displays asks first.
  • Reset Thaw clears everything but your layout and profiles, and Reset permissions forgets the files you picked.
  • Thaw reads a busy menu bar faster, and profiles and looks follow a Space switch sooner.
  • The Thaw Bar drops in from the menu bar.
  • Switch to Reduced mode from Troubleshooting, where Thaw runs as one icon that hides whole apps.
  • What's New shows its Stable, Beta and Alpha tabs beside the title.
  • Thaw does less work while the menu bar sits idle. It no longer redraws the bar's look on every click or asks about every running app every three seconds.
  • The item list in Troubleshooting also records where macOS draws each item.
  • Capture samples also include the picture Thaw kept for each hidden item.

Modules

  • Triggers, Scripts and Widgets run as small apps next to Thaw. Open each from its page in Settings. The widget icon moved there from Experiments.
  • Profile switches don't wait for a "before switching" script, and scripts go with a profile you export or copy.

Thaw's icon

  • The cube in Thaw's icon is even. Its top face no longer looks paler than its sides, and the shapes inside it share one flat cream.

Settings

  • A new sidebar, with everyday pages first, then your modules, then Modules, Privacy and Tools, and About last.
  • Modules is a grid of cards, each with the part's icon, what it does and its switch. Profiles can be turned off there too, and your saved profiles are kept.
  • Some pages moved: Displays & Spaces is now Displays, Automation became Triggers and Scripts, and Experiments' features sit on the pages they belong to.
  • Theme: System, Light, Dark or Black, in General › Language and theme, replacing "Black background in dark mode".
  • Fewer glass finishes: Glass with a Tint switch, and Liquid Glass with Edge, Sheer, Dim, Invert and Dynamic Glass.
  • The Thaw Bar's own look has a Corners slider, from square to round, and Corners sliders show their value.
  • Hide items again is one menu in Simple Mode and Visibility: Never, When I click elsewhere, When I switch apps or a delay.
  • One name for each thing across Settings and menus, with the sections called Visible, Hidden and Always Hidden and a badge on Alpha and Beta features.
  • The Thaw Bar's Location choices say where it opens, and shortcuts have their own choice, When opened by a shortcut.
  • Displays has a Template tab with the Thaw Bar and spacing settings for new displays.
  • Spacing has one warning at the top, and Layout explains Apple's items in Known macOS 27 limitations.
  • The arrow keys step through What's New and Acknowledgements, and permission icons line up.

Fixed

Layout and items

  • An item that shows live text is recognized as one item within about two minutes, such as a clock or a song title.
  • The Layout window's green button zooms it instead of going full screen, where only quitting Thaw got you out.
  • The widget icon hides again with the Native hiding method. It stayed on the menu bar in Hidden and Always Hidden.
  • Native hiding starts again when a hidden app has no entry in System Settings › Menu Bar, such as one you removed. Reported by @SebastienBn in #1513.
  • Native hiding hides your apps again when macOS puts its list back right after Thaw changed it. Reported by @macdaddy1944 in #1501.
  • An app you switched back on in System Settings says so in Layout, instead of saying macOS won't let Thaw switch it off.
  • Undo brings a moved group back whole again. It used to restore only the batch's ungrouped items.
  • Live item pictures update again when their left part changes, like right-aligned text getting shorter on an item that keeps its width.
  • Shift and the arrow keys extend the selection down the Layout window's list, and a Shift-click no longer selects rows a filter hides.
  • A read-only Layout window no longer groups the selection.
  • The order you drag the menu bar into is pinned, even when an app is slow to answer Thaw at that moment.
  • Hiding an item from Layout no longer sends Visible items to Always Hidden after Thaw restarts.
  • Items with a countdown, such as Raycast's calendar, stay put. Reported by @jasonericsiegel in #1489.
  • Items no longer move at launch or while you log in, because Thaw waits for the menu bar to settle. Fixed by @camguillory in #1452.
  • Hidden items no longer collapse right after you point at them.
  • Item pictures are no longer cut off, including on Macs with a taller menu bar, and f.lux gets its picture.
  • Capture Hidden Items is faster and counts items Native hiding parks. By @Belligerently in #1488.
  • Layout says when a drag didn't land, and refused moves point to the right setting.
  • Unresponsive apps show an hourglass, and switched-off system items show their own symbol in Layout and Search.
  • Control-click opens a row's menu in the Layout window's list, as a right click does.
  • A selection you clear or change right after a move stays that way instead of jumping back to the moved items.
  • Two same-width items of one app can no longer show each other's picture.
  • An item with a changing title is recognized after its app restarts, even when the old copy was still quitting.
  • Capture Hidden Items retakes a picture that is cut off at its left or right edge, and a cut-off picture can no longer replace a complete one.
  • A hidden item's picture is taken where macOS draws it, not at the spot its app reports, which could cut it off. (#1454)
  • Pictures of hidden items survive a restart. Restarting Thaw could lose all of them, or the saved ones it hadn't loaded yet. Reported by katla on Discord.
  • Pictures of hidden items survive an update. Each update threw them away, so hidden items showed app icons until you captured them again. Thaw now keeps them and replaces each one the next time it can take a new picture.
  • Layout keeps your selection when a move is refused or changes nothing.
  • A chosen icon now shows. Choose Icon kept showing Thaw's picture of the item. Automatic goes back to the picture.
  • Items that show up late after a restart go back to their place instead of staying next to Thaw's icon. By @Omoeba in #1531.
  • Opening a hidden item no longer opens the item next to it, and moves the pointer only when it has to. By @Omoeba in #1531.
  • "Move items that don’t fit into Hidden" moves only the items that don't fit. On a full menu bar it could move most of your Visible items to Hidden.
  • Items that don't fit stay in Hidden when you change your layout, instead of all coming back until macOS runs out of room again.
  • Capture Hidden Items says when the menu bar is full, instead of listing every hidden item as missing a picture.
  • Turning off Automatically rehide also stops hides already on their way. By @Belligerently in #1575.
  • Closing hidden items stops every section's hide timer, so an old countdown can't close items you reveal later. By @Belligerently in #1571.
  • Items you reopen with a shortcut no longer close because of an earlier click elsewhere.
  • Switching apps no longer hides items you've revealed when you move the pointer back to the menu bar or the Thaw Bar before they close. By @Belligerently in #1628.
  • A cancelled click no longer opens the item, leaves the pointer on it or waits for the pointer to stop. Partly by @Belligerently in #1578.
  • Thaw drops far fewer clicks on menu bar items while an app is frozen. By @Belligerently in #1580.
  • Thaw no longer crashes when two Apple items swap places while one is briefly unnamed. By @Belligerently in #1576.
  • Native hiding no longer mixes visible items in with hidden ones after an app launches. By @camguillory.
  • Notes in the layout editor's right-click menu are dimmed, so they don't look like commands.
  • Items with a blank name get their picture taken.
  • Layout picks up new items when macOS leaves out Thaw's own icon, and QQ and WeChat keep one item each. Reported by @Mujun05 in #1449 and fixed in #1450.
  • Capture Hidden Items no longer lists a kept picture as missing when macOS rebuilds the menu bar. Fixed by @Belligerently in #1448.
  • An Apple item that Thaw replaces, such as AirDrop, no longer shows twice in Layout and the Thaw Bar.
  • Thaw's icon can be moved again, and items stop shuffling, on Macs where macOS ignored where Thaw put its icon and dividers.
  • Pictures of hidden items fit again after you narrow the menu bar spacing. By @Omoeba in #1620.
  • An icon that got much narrower gets its new picture, such as one that stops showing text. By @Omoeba in #1620.
  • A cut-off picture no longer replaces a good one that Thaw loaded from disk. By @Omoeba in #1620.
  • A hidden item's picture is no longer taken while its icon is still sliding in. A cut-off one is left out and the item keeps the picture it had.
  • Thaw stops retrying a picture that keeps failing. An item whose picture fails on every refresh is now set aside for 30 seconds.
  • An app Thaw hides to make room keeps its picture. It was thrown away on every refresh, so the Thaw Bar showed the app's icon instead.

Thaw Bar

  • Showing a section while the Thaw Bar is open no longer hides it early.
  • The Thaw Bar keeps hidden items' pictures after macOS warns that memory is low, instead of showing app icons until they were captured again. Reported by @na-zar in #1606.
  • App menus keep their place when Always Hidden opens in the Thaw Bar, and Hidden no longer stays expanded behind the panel.
  • One click on Thaw's icon works when double-click opens Always Hidden and macOS's double-click speed is slow. Reported by @bortolatto-creator in #1492.
  • A long click on a Thaw Bar item opens it, and the arrow keys move the highlight at once.
  • The preview shows what the bar shows, and each display uses its own hover and scroll setting.
  • The Thaw Bar no longer resizes and repositions itself many times a second while the pointer moves over it.
  • The Thaw Bar settings stay available when only Always Hidden uses the bar, and the preview shows that section. By @doublezz10 in #1566.
  • The template has the Open Always Hidden in the Thaw Bar switch, as each display does.
  • App icons in the Thaw Bar match the size of the item pictures beside them.
  • Thaw stops using the Thaw Bar once macOS's overflow arrow is gone, also while Thaw's Settings is open.

Spaces and profiles

  • A thaw://apply-profile link no longer applies a profile while Profiles is turned off.
  • The profile preview shows what your items look like, with Layout's pictures and system symbols.
  • Renaming or duplicating an old profile no longer starts turning Always Hidden off on the next apply or Space switch.
  • Undo is cleared when a profile applies, so ⌘Z can't write one profile's old order into another's layout.
  • Spaces settings stay after Thaw quits, and a Space's own look survives a logout.
  • Editing the look in a Space with its own look changes that Space.
  • Applying a profile keeps shortcuts added since it was saved, and a new one saved with Always Hidden off turns it off. Older profiles still only turn it on.
  • Export All includes scripts and shortcuts, and a profile's preview lists everything it changes.
  • Undoing a new or duplicated profile keeps the profile you're on. By @Belligerently in #1487.
  • Thaw's list of Spaces updates when a display connects or disconnects.
  • Switching Spaces on a second display right after the first is no longer missed.
  • A Space indicator that could not start is fully turned off, so turning it on again starts clean.
  • thaw:// reports every per-display setting, including for a disconnected display.
  • Use Template copies the Always Hidden only choice too.
  • A profile applied as Thaw starts keeps its order when some items show up late. By @Omoeba in #1531.
  • A profile action that arrives after that profile was removed no longer clears another profile’s display or Space association. By @Belligerently in #1555.
  • Importing profiles no longer assigns one shortcut twice. By @Belligerently in #1556.
  • Undoing a profile's deletion restores its apply shortcut, unless another profile took it. By @Belligerently in #1557.
  • An apply shortcut you clear stays cleared through undo and redo.
  • Profile previews no longer list display changes that won't happen. By @Belligerently in #1572.
  • Reset all settings also clears menu bar looks saved for single Spaces. By @Belligerently in #1579.
  • Applying a profile keeps your menu bar spacing, including spacing set with a thaw:// link. Partly fixed by @Omoeba in #1451.

Search

  • ⌘E during a rename keeps the name you're typing, without a beep. By @doublezz10 in #1565.
  • Search shortcuts no longer act on an item when the key is meant for another window. By @Belligerently in #1570.
  • Search shows an item's new name at its next refresh. By @Belligerently in #1573.

Settings

  • Settings search no longer offers pages for modules you turned off.
  • The Shortcuts page no longer shows an empty Profiles tab while Profiles is turned off.
  • A search result that jumps to a row which isn't showing no longer flashes that row later.
  • Hide the menu bar opens Displays on its Spaces tab.
  • Each permission row has its own search target, so the jump lands on the one you picked.
  • Log rotation rows are left out of search while diagnostic logging is off, since the rows aren't there.
  • The Swap Bar stays off after an upgrade from a version that called it the Transport Bar.
  • Simple Mode mentions double-clicking Thaw's icon only while that shortcut is on.
  • Show Samples turns on as soon as a capture sample is saved.
  • Buttons in Settings are all one height.
  • The Logs and Item list buttons in Tools no longer look turned off.
  • About's update rows have the same separators as the other pages.
  • App language shows System Default when you haven't picked a language.
  • Recording a shortcut stops when you leave its page, and Shift-Escape cancels it.
  • The Settings window no longer shrinks right after it opens.

Other

  • thaw://release-item?bundle= lets go of every item of that app the sender holds.
  • Smart rehide no longer skips a click outside the menu bar while the Thaw icon has no window yet.
  • Smart rehide no longer hides items you just revealed while it checks for an open menu.
  • Thaw's memory no longer jumps by about 50 MB each time you switch apps or show a section with a menu bar shape, tint or shadow on.
  • The Thaw Bar preview in Settings no longer holds about 60 MB for a picture of your wallpaper.
  • Thaw restarts itself once when macOS refuses its Accessibility reads at login, instead of staying unable to see other apps' menu bar items.
  • The widget icon is redrawn only when what it shows changes, which cuts the Widgets module's memory and processor use.
  • Turning "Show release notes after an update" off keeps the window closed after Thaw updates.
  • A Mac without a battery draws its widget icon in the menu bar's own ink instead of as a fixed grey picture.
  • Reset Thaw also puts back the widgets switch, the recording alert position and Remember last search, and forgets a few remembered choices.
  • The Widgets and Scripts windows open at full size.
  • The capsule border comes back after the Mac wakes.
  • Reduce Motion keeps short fades and no longer pauses the notch panel.
  • Setup names the permission it's waiting for and what you give up without Accessibility.
  • Diagnostic logs no longer warn on every layout pass.
  • Reset Thaw no longer brings old item pictures back when a window opens right after it.
  • Setup's checkmark bounces when you grant a permission, not each time the page opens.
  • Turning diagnostic logging off no longer leaves a new log file open.
  • Show Emoji & Symbols in Thaw's Input menu opens the viewer. Reported by @Macador in #1518.
  • What's New opens on the version you have installed, not the newest release.
  • Closing What's New or a Settings page no longer leaks a little memory each time.
  • The Split shape shrinks back sooner after hiding.
  • Zen Mode stays off when you turn it off during a screen share or call, until the share or call ends. By @Belligerently in #1577.
  • The CPU widget no longer crashes after about 248 days of uptime. By @Belligerently in #1581.
  • Screenshots no longer show the Finder menus you hid on the desktop.
  • Links in the release notes open only over https, and a Wi-Fi sign-in page can't replace your saved release notes.
  • Thaw's Time Machine icon keeps updating when Time Machine stops answering.
  • Option-right-click on empty menu bar space opens Thaw's menu. On macOS 27.2 a plain right-click there opens Apple's menu instead.

Thanks

  • @Omoeba stopped the test suite from resetting your Mac's menu bar spacing (#1533).
  • @elior-esh took on the November review in #1529. They documented every thaw:// action and setting (#1532), added tests for the Profiles pages, tips and widgets (#1538, #1539, #1541, #1542, #1546, #1548) and tidied the code behind them (#1544, #1545). They also fixed six weak tests (#1550), moved the Layout list's checkbox sweep out of its page (#1551), fuzzed a missing thaw:// route (#1552), ran each package's tests in CI (#1553) and tested the Displays pages (#1561, #1564).
  • @doublezz10 added isolated previews for the Visibility settings and documented them (#1567, #1568).
  • @Belligerently made the accessibility read test independent of timing (#1574) and tested the Settings pages (#1582, #1584, #1586, #1587).

  • An apply shortcut you clear stays cleared through undo and redo.
  • Profile previews no longer list display changes that won't happen. By @Belligerently in #1572.
  • Reset all settings also clears menu bar looks saved for single Spaces. By @Belligerently in #1579.

Search

  • With Compact search showing only its field, keys no longer act on a row you can't see. The arrow keys move the cursor in the field.
  • A wrong letter no longer clears what you typed, the arrow keys keep working after the menu bar changes, and recent items show once.
  • A failed move from search stays up and is read aloud.
  • A row is listed once while its item is mid-move, so the arrow keys don't stall on it.
  • Return and the arrow keys are left to a Japanese or Chinese input method while it is composing text.
  • A rename ends when its item leaves the search results, instead of blocking keys until Escape.
  • Tab reaches the search buttons after the last section, and Shift-Tab before the first.
  • ⌘E during a rename keeps the name you're typing, without a beep. By @doublezz10 in #1565.
  • Search shortcuts no longer act on an item when the key is meant for another window. By @Belligerently in #1570.
  • Search shows an item's new name at its next refresh. By @Belligerently in #1573.

Settings

  • A search result that jumps to a row which isn't showing no longer flashes that row later.
  • Hide the menu bar opens Displays on its Spaces tab.
  • Each permission row has its own search target, so the jump lands on the one you picked.
  • Log rotation rows are left out of search while diagnostic logging is off, since the rows aren't there.
  • The Swap Bar stays off after an upgrade from a version that called it the Transport Bar.
  • Simple Mode mentions double-clicking Thaw's icon only while that shortcut is on.
  • Show Samples turns on as soon as a capture sample is saved.
  • Buttons in Settings are all one height. The button groups on About and Tools and the filled buttons were taller, and the buttons on Displays and the Thaw Bar page were smaller.
  • The Logs and Item list buttons in Tools no longer look turned off.
  • About's update rows have the same separators as the other pages.

Other

  • The widget icon is redrawn only when what it shows changes, which cuts the Widgets module's memory and processor use.
  • With the Native hiding method, Thaw no longer watches every click and drag for a press on the clock. Only Standard needs that.
  • Turning "Show release notes after an update" off keeps the window closed after Thaw updates.
  • A Mac without a battery draws its widget icon in the menu bar's own ink instead of as a fixed grey picture.
  • Reset Thaw also puts back the widgets switch, the recording alert position and Remember last search, and forgets what it checked about your allowed apps.
  • The Widgets and Scripts windows open at full size.
  • The capsule border comes back after the Mac wakes.
  • Reduce Motion keeps short fades and no longer pauses the notch panel.
  • Setup names the permission it's waiting for and what you give up without Accessibility.
  • Diagnostic logs no longer warn on every layout pass.
  • Reset Thaw no longer brings old item pictures back when a window opens right after it.
  • Setup's checkmark bounces when you grant a permission, not each time the page opens.
  • Turning diagnostic logging off no longer leaves a new log file open.
  • Restarting Thaw keeps saved item pictures it hadn't loaded yet.
  • Show Emoji & Symbols in Thaw's Input menu opens the viewer. Reported by @Macador in #1518.
  • What's New opens on the version you have installed, not the newest release.
  • Closing What's New or a Settings page no longer leaks a little memory each time.
  • The Split shape shrinks back sooner after hiding. Once the hidden icons were gone, the shape around the icons could stay stretched for a second or two with nothing in it. It now shrinks as soon as the menu bar has settled.
  • Zen Mode stays off when you turn it off during a screen share or call, until the share or call ends. By @Belligerently in #1577.
  • The CPU widget no longer crashes after about 248 days of uptime. By @Belligerently in #1581.

Thanks

  • @Omoeba stopped the test suite from resetting your Mac's menu bar spacing (#1533).
  • @elior-esh took on the November review in #1529. They documented every thaw:// action and setting (#1532), added tests for the Profiles pages, tips and widgets (#1538, #1539, #1541, #1542, #1546, #1548) and tidied the code behind them (#1544, #1545). They also fixed six weak tests (#1550), moved the Layout list's checkbox sweep out of its page (#1551), fuzzed a missing thaw:// route (#1552), ran each package's tests in CI (#1553) and tested the Displays pages (#1561, #1564).
  • @doublezz10 added isolated previews for the Visibility settings and documented them (#1567, #1568).
  • @Belligerently made the accessibility read test independent of timing (#1574) and tested the Settings pages (#1582, #1584, #1586, #1587).

item.title: 3.0.0-alpha.13
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 124

Scripts, Triggers and Widgets become modules you can switch on and off, and Settings is rebuilt on ThawUI. Your settings, triggers, scripts and widget design carry over. By @diazdesandi.

New

  • Modules. Settings › Extras switches optional parts of Thaw on and off. A module that's off doesn't run and leaves the sidebar. Scripts, Triggers and Widgets come first, and each starts on if you already used it.

Changed

Modules

  • Triggers, Scripts and Widgets run as small apps next to Thaw. Open each from its page in Settings. The widget icon moved there from Experiments.
  • Profile switches don't wait for a "before switching" script to finish before the layout changes. Scripts also run for the profile Thaw applies as it starts, and go with a profile you export or copy.

Thaw's icon

  • The cube in Thaw's icon is even. Its top face no longer looks paler than its sides, and the shapes inside it share one flat cream.

Settings

  • A new sidebar. Everyday pages come first, then your modules, then Extras, Privacy and Tools, with About last. The arrow keys move between pages.
  • Extras is a grid of cards, each with the part's icon, what it does and its switch. Profiles can be turned off there too, and your saved profiles are kept.
  • Some pages moved. Displays & Spaces is now Displays. Automation became Triggers and Scripts, with thaw:// app permissions on Privacy and switching profiles by display or Space on Profiles. Experiments is gone, and its features sit on the pages they belong to with an Alpha or Beta badge. Old links to these pages still open.
  • Theme: System, Light, Dark or Black, for Settings and onboarding, in General › Language and theme. Black suits OLED displays and replaces "Black background in dark mode".
  • Fewer glass finishes. The Effect menu has Glass, with a Tint switch, and a Liquid Glass section with Edge, Sheer, Dim, Invert and Dynamic Glass. Saved looks keep how they looked.
  • The Thaw Bar's own look has a Corners slider, from square to round, instead of the Rounded corners switch.
  • Every Search style can rename and move items. The styles are now Detailed, Compact and Large, and all three share the bottom bar: ⌘E renames, ⌘K shows actions and ⌘1 to ⌘3 move an item.
  • Hide items again is one menu in Simple Mode and Visibility: Never, When I click elsewhere, When I switch apps or a delay.
  • One name for each thing. Settings and menus now agree, and Alpha and Beta features carry a badge. Reset Positions is now Rebuild Saved Layout, Hide again after is Keep opened items in the menu bar for, and Open hidden items in the menu bar is Show clicked items in the menu bar.
  • The Thaw Bar's Location choices say where it opens, and shortcuts have their own choice, When opened by a shortcut.
  • Displays has a Template tab with the Thaw Bar and spacing settings for new displays.
  • Spacing has one warning at the top, and Layout explains Apple's items in Known macOS 27 limitations.
  • The arrow keys step through What's New and Acknowledgements, and permission icons line up.

Fixed

  • App language shows System Default when you haven't picked a language.
  • Layout and Search show the symbol of Bluetooth and other system items that Thaw switched off, and one grey placeholder for items Thaw can't identify.
  • Screenshots no longer show the Finder menus you hid on the desktop.
  • Notes in the layout editor's right-click menu are dimmed, so they don't look like commands.
  • Links in the release notes open only over https, and a Wi-Fi sign-in page can't replace your saved release notes.
  • Recording a shortcut stops when you leave its page, and Shift-Escape cancels it.
  • The Settings window no longer shrinks right after it opens.
  • App icons in the Thaw Bar match the size of the item pictures beside them.
  • A cancelled click no longer waits for the pointer to stop.
  • Items with a blank name get their picture taken.
  • Thaw's Time Machine icon keeps updating when Time Machine stops answering.
  • Layout picks up new items when macOS leaves out Thaw's own icon, and QQ and WeChat keep one item each as their unread count changes. Reported by @Mujun05 in #1449 and fixed in #1450.
  • Applying a profile keeps your menu bar spacing, at startup and when you change Space or Focus. Fixed by @Omoeba in #1451.
  • Thaw waits for the menu bar to settle before moving items, while you log in and when the menu bar moves to another display. Fixed by @camguillory in #1452.
  • Capture Hidden Items no longer lists a kept picture as missing when macOS rebuilds the menu bar. Fixed by @Belligerently in #1448.
  • Option-right-click on empty menu bar space opens Thaw's menu. On macOS 27.2 a plain right-click there opens Apple's menu instead.

item.title: 3.0.0-beta.6
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 123

Fixes for beta 5, two small additions and an alpha setting for the Thaw Bar.

Note

On a macOS version before 27.2?

This beta may have problems there. Some are already known, such as the macOS 27.0.1 full-screen bug; see Known macOS 27 limitations. If Thaw got slower or less responsive after you updated and it isn't listed there, please open an issue with your macOS version and a diagnostic log.

New

  • Show on hover works on Thaw's icon too. Rest the pointer on Thaw's icon and your hidden items appear, as they do over an empty part of the menu bar. A click on the icon right after they appear keeps them open. Suggested by @daniilsys in #1431.
  • Choose how large items are in the Thaw Bar (alpha). Settings › Thaw Bar has an Item size slider for each display, from 60% to 100% of the items' size in the menu bar. Smaller sizes fit more items in a row. The menu bar, Layout and search keep their sizes, and 100%, the default, looks as before. Requested by @mannycastaneda in #1388.
  • A list of every file Thaw keeps. Where Thaw keeps its files says what each one holds and which you can copy to another Mac or keep in a dotfiles repo. Requested by @pikeas in #1363.

Changed

  • Turning the Thaw Bar on or off is clearer. Settings › Thaw Bar asks where to show hidden items: In the menu bar, In the Thaw Bar, or Always in the menu bar. The text below it says whether the Thaw Bar is on, and the preview's button reads Turn On & Open.
  • Capture Hidden Items leaves good pictures alone. It now retakes only pictures that are missing or too small to be an icon, since each item it shows on the menu bar is another chance at a worse picture. Hold Option when you click it to retake every picture. It also waits for an icon to hold still a little longer before taking its picture, and keeps the picture it has over a new one where the icon is drawn much smaller, as it is while it grows back in. With Native hiding it no longer skips items that macOS moves after showing them: it waits for them where they end up. It leaves out Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and the other items Thaw hides by switching them off in Control Center, since showing them for a picture never draws them, so a capture is quicker.
  • Stable and beta updates reach Macs in stages. Thaw offers a new version to a few Macs at a time, so a bad update can be stopped before it reaches everyone. Your Mac can get it up to two days after it comes out, and checking for updates yourself finds it right away.
  • Pull requests get a security review from Strix, an AI security testing tool, when they open. It adds to the checks we already run, and maintainers decide what to fix. The security assurance case lists it with the rest.

Fixed

  • One click on empty menu bar space opens or closes the Thaw Bar once. A single click could open the bar and close it straight away, or close it and open it again, so the click seemed to do nothing. Double-clicking for Always Hidden items works as before. Reported by @RonenMars in #1440.
  • Pictures of hidden items are no longer cut off. Thaw took the picture while revealed icons could still be sliding into place. It now waits until they stop moving, for up to a second more.
  • Capture Hidden Items no longer saves cut-off pictures while Settings is open. Thaw kept refreshing pictures of the menu bar in the background while Capture Hidden Items showed hidden items one at a time, and could take a picture of one as it slid into place. Those refreshes now wait until Capture Hidden Items is done.
  • Capture Hidden Items counts only what it captured. The count included older pictures kept after a failed try. It now counts new pictures only, leaves out items with nothing to capture, and names the rest as having no new picture.
  • Capture Hidden Items gets pictures of apps hidden with Native hiding. Thaw measured such an icon where it sat while hidden, then turned the picture down because the icon had moved. If an icon moves after Thaw measured it, Thaw now measures it again in its new place. The Thaw Bar and Layout take their pictures the same way and get the fix too.
  • Hidden items whose app Thaw couldn't identify open again. macOS can list a hidden item without the app that owns it, and every way Thaw opens an item needs that app, so clicking one from the Thaw Bar or Search did nothing and the pointer disappeared for a moment. Thaw now finds the app from the app ID stored with the item. Reported in #1119.
  • Hidden items keep their pictures. Thaw hides Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and Sound by turning off their Control Center modules, so it can't show them again to take a new picture. A picture taken before you hid one was thrown away after 10 minutes, and the item showed a placeholder. Pictures of hidden items now last until Thaw has been closed for a week.
  • Bluetooth and other system items show their own symbol when Thaw has no picture of them. Thaw hides Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and Sound by switching them off, so it can't photograph one it has no picture of yet. Instead of a generic placeholder, each now shows its own symbol until Thaw has a picture.
  • Hidden icons no longer shuffle each time you show them with Native hiding. macOS puts the apps back where it remembers them, and Thaw tried to move each one, which macOS ignored. Thaw now leaves them where macOS puts them. It also stops retrying any icon macOS refused to move until something changes, such as your layout or display.
  • Visible icons, Thaw's own included, no longer disappear after you put something in Hidden. The Always Hidden divider could end up among your visible icons, and everything left of it was hidden. Thaw now moves the divider back left of your Hidden items. Reported by @DoNotResuscitate in #1329.
  • iStat Menus Weather and Time items keep their place. Thaw tells iStat items apart by their titles. The Weather title changes with the conditions, and the Time title changes between AM and PM and every month. Each change made Thaw treat the item as new, so it snapped back after you moved it. Thaw now leaves those words out when it names the item. An item with your connected devices in its title, such as Battery, can still lose its place. Reported by @crimsonsunset in #1445.
  • An app hidden with Native hiding stays hidden after you move it back. Moving an app's icon out of Hidden and back could leave some of its items in Visible. The app doesn't draw them, so Layout doesn't show them, but they kept the whole app in the menu bar. Moving an app's icon between sections now takes those items along. If an app is stuck in the menu bar this way, move its icon to Visible and back to Hidden.
  • Thaw's widget keeps its place. Thaw named the widget by its readings, so each change in battery or Wi-Fi strength made it a new item. A drop next to it could land somewhere else, and its position wasn't kept. The widget now has a fixed name, and its saved position carries over.
  • Notion Calendar keeps its place. Its menu bar item shows the next event and the minutes left, such as "Standup · 13 m left", and has no title between events. Each change made it a new item. Thaw now treats every Notion Calendar title as the same item.

item.title: 3.0.0-beta.5
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 122

Note

Contributing is easier now

AGENTS.md tells AI coding agents, and the people using them, how to contribute to Thaw. CODING_STANDARDS.md says how code and text are written here. Read both before you open a pull request, whether you write the change yourself or with an agent.

If an AI helps with your change, see the AI-assisted contributions section of our contribution guidelines first: you stay responsible for the change and must be able to explain it, and the tool's terms have to let you contribute its output.

Important

On the Alpha channel? Read this before the next update.

Alpha 13 reworks a lot of Thaw, including Settings zoom and the new modules for scripts, triggers and widgets, and it's likely to crash more than usual.

To skip it for now, go to Settings › About and set Update channel to Beta. You'll stay on beta 5 and can switch back when you're ready. If you'd like to help test, stay on Alpha, and please send logs from any crashes.

This beta has every fix from alpha.11, alpha.12 and the alpha.12.1 hotfix. Most of them keep menu bar items where you put them, or tighten which apps can use thaw:// links.

New

  • Capture hidden items on request. Settings › Layout has a button, next to Pop Out Editor, that takes new pictures of your Hidden and Always Hidden items and says which ones it couldn't get. It also works with the Native hiding method, where icons can move while it runs. By @diazdesandi. Related: #1437.
  • You can skip menu bar visibility recovery when a removed app blocks it. Thaw keeps the recovery records as backups and leaves Native hiding off.
  • Settings can use a pure black background in dark mode. Turn on "Black background in dark mode" in General if you have an OLED display. Light mode looks the same as before, and the sidebar, toolbar and rows keep their glass.

Changed

  • The buttons in Appearance > Advanced and the Click, Hover and Scroll switches in Visibility match the rest of Settings. In #1429.
  • Thaw no longer moves your pointer to reorder menu bar items. When macOS declines a move, the item stays where it is. Before, Thaw dragged it with a simulated mouse drag, which could leave the pointer or the item stuck. By @camguillory in #1418.
  • thaw:// links are stricter about who they trust. A sender's developer team counts only when Apple vouches for it. An app signed some other way is approved by its own signature, so it can't claim a trusted team. Replies go only to the app that asked, checked by its signature. Before, any app that handled the same link could receive them. In Reduced Mode, thaw://hide-app and thaw://show-app need an app you allowed, since they change which apps stay hidden. thaw://toggle-hidden still works for anyone.
  • The known macOS 27 limitations are in the Hiding section now, behind an info button next to the hiding method, instead of a card at the top of Layout.
  • thaw://proxy-press needs settings access and an app you allowed, like thaw://set, since it presses another app's menu bar item.
  • thaw://toggle-thawbar needs settings access, like thaw://set and thaw://toggle, since it saves a setting.
  • thaw://dump-items needs settings access, and reports back only to the app that asked. It no longer opens web links.
  • An imported profile arrives with "Ask before restarting" on, and Thaw refuses a file with more than 100 profiles.
  • thawctl get says it can't return a value instead of sending a request whose reply goes nowhere. Read settings from the ThawCtl app or your own app's callback.
  • One "Hidden items" picker replaces the "Use Thaw Bar" and "Always show hidden items" switches. Choose On click, Thaw Bar or Always shown for each display and for the global template. Your saved choice carries over, and thaw://set works as before.

Fixed

  • Thaw no longer tries to move or hide tray icons listed as explorer.exe, which come from Windows apps in CrossOver and Wine. macOS reports no app identity for them, and hiding depends on one, so Layout keeps them in Visible. With the Standard hiding method, macOS may not draw them at all. Reported by @promarcel in #1310.
  • Opening the Thaw Bar or Layout no longer keeps revealing an item that failed to capture. It gets another try after a short wait, or when you click Capture Hidden Items. In #1429.
  • Turning off Replace Control Center items gives Focus and the other Control Center items back. With New Items set to Hidden, Thaw filed each replacement there as a new icon. Turning the option off then left the original in Hidden too, so while Thaw ran, Focus stayed off the bar and its System Settings switch stayed off. A replacement now stays where the original was, and turning the option off puts the original back. Reported by @RonenMars in #1435.
  • No darker strip beside the notch while Thaw takes pictures of hidden icons. The cover over that part of the bar painted Thaw's tint even with no menu bar shape, where the bar itself doesn't show it. Reported by @ztm-njau in #1438.
  • Two Live Activities from one app keep their pictures. They share a name, so Thaw couldn't tell them apart and erased the picture on every refresh. It now tells them apart by position. In #1429.
  • Taking pictures of menu bar items no longer captures your whole display. Thaw now reads only the menu bar's own window, which should stop protected video from blacking out while Settings or the Thaw Bar is open. It captures the display only if it can't read that window, and these captures run only in Thaw's separate capture helper. Related: #1413. In #1429.
  • Thaw no longer keeps a picture of what's behind the menu bar. Instead of refreshing one on a timer, it takes one only when it's about to show hidden items to photograph them, and drops it when the cover goes away. Related: #1413. In #1429.

Menu bar order

  • Control Center controls you pinned to the menu bar stay where macOS puts them. Thaw counted a pinned control such as Screenshot, Timer or Calculator as a Visible item it could move. macOS places those controls itself, so each time you showed your hidden items Thaw shuffled the icons around them for a few seconds and then gave up. Thaw now leaves them to macOS, and Layout says so if you try to move one.
  • Icons Thaw can't read in time stay where they are. When an app answered Thaw too slowly, its icons were moved next to Thaw's icon, out of Hidden or Always Hidden, and sometimes past Thaw's icon.
  • Icons from an app that is slow to start at login keep their section. Until the app answers on time, its icons arrive under a placeholder name, and Thaw placed them in Visible as new items. OneDrive calls every icon "OneDrive" until its accounts load, so with Native hiding the whole app showed even when you had hidden it. Thaw now waits for a slow app to answer, and gives each OneDrive icon, left to right, the account you saved it under. Once OneDrive names its accounts, Thaw uses those names. Reported by @michaeljauk in #1416.
  • An icon that publishes no name of its own, like Stats' Disk icon, can be moved again. Thaw tied it to an old entry left behind by Thaw itself, so it stayed at the far end of the bar and pulled the app's other icons after it.
  • Droppy's menu bar icon can be moved while its player is showing. Thaw saved the move under an entry macOS doesn't use for that icon, so the icon snapped back.
  • Dragging an item across the Hidden divider moves only that item. The neighbours the drop pushed along used to change section too, and the item you dragged could stay behind when macOS renewed it during the drag. Fixed by @camguillory in #1411.
  • After a display change, Thaw leaves your items alone while it reads the Hidden divider on the wrong side of the Clock. It used to move them into Hidden, or save that order as yours. Fixed by @camguillory in #1407.
  • Items moved to Hidden by automatic overflow remain available in Layout and the Thaw Bar when Native hiding removes them from the menu bar.
  • Your saved menu bar order holds when icons go missing or overflow. An icon that briefly disappears keeps its place, icons behind the overflow arrows keep their order while you edit Visible, Always Hidden keeps its items while it's turned off, and items a profile doesn't mention stay where they were.
  • Focus, Sound and other items macOS shows only some of the time go back to their place in your layout when they reappear, instead of staying where macOS put them. This was one way the Visible order drifted during the day in Automatic arrangement. Reported by @michaeljauk in #1410.
  • Thaw can put your Visible order back when the bar has an item your layout doesn't name yet, such as Now Playing. That item stays where it is, and the others return to your order. Before, Thaw gave up after three tries. Reported by @michaeljauk in #1410.
  • You can move items to the right of Siri on macOS 27. macOS doesn't pin Siri, so Thaw no longer treats it as fixed or moves it back to the end.
  • Dragging an item inside Hidden keeps your Always Hidden items in Always Hidden while that section is turned off.
  • Dropping a Visible item back where it was keeps the saved place of Visible items that are off screen at that moment.
  • Clock, Control Center and other system items you put in Hidden stay there after you switch away from Standard hiding and back. Thaw used to forget their place the first time it checked the bar with Standard hiding off.
  • Moving an item no longer pushes its neighbours into Hidden or Always Hidden, and no longer moves the item you dropped it next to when two items shared a position.
  • Thaw can restore your Visible order after every item in front of the Hidden divider has moved across it. Before, some items got no place and stayed where they were.

Menu bar and appearance

  • The menu bar shape hides when Mission Control opens and returns when it closes. Fixed by @Belligerently in #1425.
  • Opening a hidden item no longer keeps an auto-hiding menu bar on screen. Thaw shows the item before pressing it. Fixed by @cnicc in #1409.
  • An app that Native hiding keeps off the menu bar shows its app icon in the Thaw Bar and Layout. Before, they showed a generic window shape, and Thaw revealed the hidden item to take its picture. Reported by @lucifercraig12345-create in #1424. Fixed by @camguillory in #1408.
  • The Right margin works with the Split shape. The right half now ends that far from the screen edge, like the left half does with the Left margin. Before, the slider did nothing, and the right half ended close to the Clock's text. Reported by @jaimefordham in #1412.
  • Thaw stays responsive when the app in front stops answering. When Thaw reads where that app's menus end, it now stops waiting after a moment.
  • Thaw no longer quits when a group folder's icon briefly has no window. On macOS 27 that happens after the menu bar rearranges, and Thaw read the placeholder number macOS gives such an icon as a window ID. Reported by @perlytiara in #1397.
  • Timed rehide hides the section again even if you don't move the pointer after showing it with a shortcut or a click.
  • A system item's stand-in turned off while it was starting no longer keeps running.
  • The Thaw Bar draws an app's icon at menu bar size when it has no picture of the item yet, instead of nearly twice the height of the icons around it on a notched display. Reported by @eisaias2000 in #1401.
  • Search lists the same items as Layout, including hidden items macOS isn't drawing at the moment, and no longer lists items from apps you quit.
  • The screen recording indicator no longer blinks on and off during full-screen video. Thaw re-read the strip behind the menu bar every 20 seconds, which macOS counts as recording the video. It now skips that while the bar is hidden, and reads again only when a window under the bar moved. Reported by @edhinnig in #1413.

Profiles and icons

  • Updating all of a profile's settings and layout keeps its pre/post scripts. Fixed by @Belligerently in #1423.
  • A profile whose saved file is missing can be removed from the list. Fixed by @Belligerently in #1420.
  • A large picture chosen as an item's icon is saved at icon size. Before, Thaw kept the whole picture in its settings.
  • A shortcut with an impossible key code no longer makes Thaw quit, when a profile with one is applied or at the next launch. Thaw skips that shortcut.
  • Another app can't switch your profile by pretending a Focus started or ended. Thaw checks the Focus state itself before it switches.
  • Applying a profile no longer restarts menu bar apps without asking. With spacing set to ask first, the Profiles pane asks, and a profile applied from the menu, a shortcut, Shortcuts, a link, a Focus or a Space saves its spacing for when the apps next start.
  • The profile preview warns that applying will restart menu bar apps when the profile has its own spacing for the display you're on.
  • The profile preview shows when a profile only reorders items in a section, instead of saying nothing would change.
  • When a Focus ends, Thaw switches to the current Space's profile if it has one, as it does at launch, rather than the display's.
  • A Focus profile stays on when Thaw can't read the Focus state. Only the system reporting that the Focus ended switches back.

thaw:// links and thawctl

  • Relaunch Now can't run commands hidden in the name of the folder Thaw is in.
  • An app you allowed to use thaw:// links is checked by its own signature, so another app can't borrow the permission by using the same name. An app allowed without a signing team is asked again when its code changes.
  • thawctl set accepts the key=value form its help shows, such as thawctl set showOnHover=true.
  • An app you add by hand under Automation can use thaw:// links. It's pinned to its own signature, like an app you allow from the prompt, instead of being listed but always refused.
  • thaw://move-item answers notApplied when the menu bar doesn't take a move to Visible. It used to answer moved once the order was saved. Reported by @michaeljauk in #1410.

Recovery and translations

  • Restored translations for menu bar controls, appearance, overflow and Zen Mode that had fallen back to English after labels or punctuation changed.
  • The recovery warning no longer reports every failed restore as an unreadable Control Center setting.

Updates

  • Switching between Alpha and Beta checks for updates right away. When Settings ran as a separate app, Thaw waited for its next daily check, so you had to press Check for Updates.

Known issues

  • On macOS 27.0.1, videos in a browser can't go full screen, and the menu bar can stay on screen over full-screen apps. This is a macOS 27 bug, not one in Thaw. Quitting MenuBarAgent in Activity Monitor fixes it until it comes back. Reported by @deadcoder0904 in #1404.

item.title: 3.0.0-alpha.12.1
item.description:
macOS 27 only · Build 120

A hotfix for alpha.12. Nothing else changed.

Fixed

  • Control Center controls you pinned to the menu bar stay where macOS puts them. Thaw counted a pinned control such as Screenshot, Timer or Calculator as a Visible item it could move. macOS places those controls itself, so each time you showed your hidden items Thaw shuffled the icons around them for a few seconds and then gave up. Thaw now leaves them alone, and Layout tells you to hold ⌘ and drag the control in the menu bar instead.

item.title: 2.2.0-beta.2
item.description:
macOS 15 and 26 · Build 65

A Homebrew tap for Thaw 2, a simpler Settings and three fixes. Your settings carry over.

You can also make your own Thaw icon on the website. It's drawn in your browser, and Get Info in Finder puts it on Thaw.

New

  • Thaw 2 has its own Homebrew tap. Homebrew's thaw cask moves to Thaw 3 with 3.0.0. Thaw shows the commands to switch once, with a button that copies them, and the tap's page lists them too.

Changed

  • Settings has fewer pages. Trigger Sources is part of Triggers, Tools is now Troubleshooting, and Language is in General.
  • One Show hidden items choice in Displays: in the menu bar, in the Thaw Bar or always in the menu bar. It replaces two switches.
  • Quit and Clear Cache is gone from Troubleshooting. Thaw already drops old item pictures when it starts.

Fixed

  • A trigger no longer leaves the pointer at the top right of the screen when it shows an item for the app in front.
  • No screen recording dot over full-screen apps. Thaw stops capturing the menu bar while a full-screen app covers it.
  • Importing a profile no longer takes its Space or display from the profile that already uses it.

macOS 26 only

Hey, we have a website! The docs, the changelog and the roadmap are at getthaw.app.

The feature release for macOS 26 that 2.0.0 promised. Items can move on their own when something happens, related items stay together in groups, Zen Mode closes the whole menu bar with one hotkey, and Simple Mode fits Settings on one page. Screen Recording is now optional. Six betas led here, and most of what changed after the first one came from your reports. The beta entries below have the detail.

After you update:

  1. Profiles, saved layouts and hotkeys carry over. There is nothing to redo.
  2. Trigger conditions other than battery and power stay off until you switch them on under Trigger Sources.
  3. If you'd rather Thaw never restarts apps for a spacing change, set When applying spacing to Wait until next restart in Settings > Displays.
  4. With Homebrew, use the thaw cask. thaw@beta is Thaw 3, which needs macOS 27. #1221
  5. If something looks wrong, open an issue.

New

Triggers

  • Items move when something happens. A trigger can react to battery level, power, an app, the network, a VPN, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, an audio device, a display, a time, a Focus, a place, Energy Mode, heat, the camera or microphone, a script, or another icon changing. Conditions can be combined, and an action can be reversed. By @alvst in #735 and #965.
  • Icon-change triggers can be strict or loose. Loose ignores tiny redraws, strict reacts to any change, and the editor shows the icon it compares against. #1006
  • A trigger can follow an external drive, so a drive's helper app shows while the drive is plugged in. Requested by @lucifercraig12345-create in #1053.

Layout

  • Groups keep related items together. They move and hide as one, even across sections.
  • Spacers add a gap of the width you choose, with an optional fill.
  • Sort a section A to Z from its heading in Layout. #936
  • Layout opens in its own window, and you can open an item straight from it. #985
  • Opened items can stay a while. An item you open from search or the Thaw Bar can stay up to 30 seconds after its menu closes. Set it under Settings > General > After revealing. #342

Modes and profiles

  • Zen Mode closes every section with one hotkey. Hovering, automatic reveals and blinking icons can't open them until you turn it off.
  • Simple Mode shows Settings as one page. Switch it off to get everything back.
  • A profile can follow a Space, the way it already follows a display, and each Space can have its own menu bar look.

Appearance

  • The Thaw Bar has its own shape, tint and border. Requested by @kn666 in #248.
  • A new wallpaper re-tints the menu bar right away, and the adaptive gradient uses the wallpaper's main colours instead of one average.

Smaller things

  • Blinking icons can show themselves. An item that asks for attention briefly opens its section. Off by default, under Advanced.
  • A hotkey for automatic rehiding. By @nightah in #665.
  • Thaw can stay out of the Dock while you show and hide items. Turn on "Hide Dock icon when toggling the menu bar" in General. #1128
  • Remove a display you no longer use from the Per Display list. #1054
  • A Tools pane gathers the troubleshooting helpers.
  • Logs are easier to send. Diagnostic logs rotate on their own, by @nk-tedo-001 in #974. When an automatic move fails, Thaw saves a report you can attach to an issue. #994

Changed

  • Screen Recording is optional. An item Thaw can't capture shows as its app's icon, so the Thaw Bar, Layout and search work without the permission. Turn on "Show app icons instead of live previews" and the recording indicator goes away. #1051
  • Thaw stays out of your way while it moves items. It waits until you stop using the mouse and keyboard, leaves the pointer where you put it, and stops instead of trying the same move again and again. Your own drags always go through.
  • Thaw asks before every automatic app restart when "Confirm before relaunching apps" is on, not only after a display change. #1098
  • Hidden icons refresh as often as the slider says. By @camguillory in #942.
  • Displays has one Per display section instead of a block for each display, and marks displays with their own settings as Custom. #1045
  • "Dev Mode Flags" is now "Trigger Sources".
  • Search, About and the welcome screens follow your text size.
  • More of Thaw is translated, Russian most of all. Help at crowdin.com/project/thaw.

Fixed

Spacing

  • Changing the spacing no longer makes Spotlight disappear until you restart the Mac. Fixed by @commanderk33n in #720.
  • Changing the spacing no longer quits system services that can't be started again, and an app that says no to quitting is left running. Reported by @wiper2 in #1070.
  • The spacing prompt stays away after you cancel it, and "Don't ask again" sticks. #1180

Order and moving

  • Applying a profile no longer pushes your visible items into Hidden. Reported by @nk-tedo-001 in #1027.
  • Reordering items in Hidden works again. #1074, #1102, #1133
  • Items you drop into Always Hidden stay there. #1190
  • New apps land at the "New items" spot, not next to the Thaw icon. #1069
  • A revealed item shows on the right side of the arrow. #1035
  • A move right after an app updates no longer snaps back. Reported by @Chamiu in #1058.
  • The iPhone Mirroring Live Activity can be moved. Reported by @mi3suuu.
  • The Thaw icon stays put when you reconnect a display on a Mac with a notch.
  • An item no longer gets stuck in one place after a rehide fails, and duplicate Control Center items on non-English Macs are cleaned up. Reported by @balaji-dutt in #1079 and #1080.
  • Thaw no longer freezes its item list because of a window left behind by an earlier Thaw. #1032

Menu bar and Thaw Bar

  • Clicking a menu like File no longer opens Hidden in apps such as Firefox. #1028
  • Scrolling on the Thaw icon opens Hidden. #1073
  • A quit app no longer leaves an icon in the Thaw Bar. #1149
  • The Thaw Bar shows the right icons on every display, light or dark, and keeps them. #1065, #1046
  • No empty gap at launch when the Thaw icon is switched off. #1043
  • Clicking one of Apple's own items opens its menu.
  • Thaw no longer acts on a menu bar macOS never finished drawing. Reported by @ppocass in #1060.

Settings and search

  • The search panel takes your first keystroke. #969
  • Typing in the Settings search no longer freezes Thaw, and adding a spacer no longer crashes it. Reported by @lucifercraig12345-create in #1055 and #1056.
  • The Smart rehide delay can be seen and changed. #1049

Memory and speed

  • Thaw's memory grows more slowly over days of uptime. It redraws only what changed and stops capturing while your displays sleep. If you still see it grow, please comment on #1129.
  • Icons refresh without slowing Thaw down, and a blink trigger watches only its own items.

item.title: 1.3.0-beta.1
item.description:
1.3.0-beta.1: Profiles & Reliability

This beta introduces Settings Profiles, allowing you to save and switch between different Thaw configurations. Profiles can be triggered automatically based on display changes or Focus modes.

New Features:

  • Settings Profiles: Save your entire Thaw configuration as a profile and switch between different setups instantly. Perfect for different workflows, presentations, or multi-monitor configurations.
    • Create, duplicate, rename, and delete profiles
    • Import and export profiles for backup or sharing
    • Update existing profiles with current layout, configuration, or both
    Thanks to @nightah for implementing this feature!
  • Display Auto-Switch: Assign profiles to specific displays. When you connect a display, its associated profile is automatically applied.
  • Focus Mode Integration: Switch profiles automatically when Focus modes activate. Add Thaw as a Focus Filter in System Settings → Focus → [Mode] → Focus Filters to assign a profile to each Focus mode. The previous profile is restored when the Focus mode deactivates.
  • Profile Hotkeys: Assign keyboard shortcuts to quickly switch between your favorite profiles.
  • New Items Badge: A draggable badge in Menu Bar Layout settings lets you control exactly where newly detected menu bar items will appear. Drag it to position new items to the left or right of existing icons.
  • Option-Click Always Hidden: New setting to toggle the always-hidden section with Option+click on empty menu bar space.
  • Icon Overflow for Notch Displays: Improved handling of menu bar items on MacBooks with a notch. Items that would be hidden behind the notch are now properly managed.

Improvements & Fixes:

  • App Menu Click-Through: Fixed issues where clicking on application menus (File, Edit, View, etc.) would incorrectly trigger Thaw's show-on-click, hover, or scroll behaviors. App menus now work reliably.
  • Event Monitor Recovery: Added automatic health checking and recovery for background event monitors. If mouse click detection stops working, Thaw now recovers automatically instead of requiring a restart.
  • Layout Bar Stability: Fixed items disappearing from the layout bar during reorder operations, after reset, or when new items appear.
  • New Items Badge Position: Fixed the badge jumping to incorrect positions when reordering other items around it. The badge now stays in place unless explicitly dragged.
  • IceBar Click Responsiveness: Reduced click jitter when interacting with items in the IceBar.
  • Context Menu Size: Fixed context menus appearing unexpectedly large in certain situations.
  • Secondary Display Support: Fixed right-click context menu not working on secondary displays.

This is a beta release. Please report any issues you encounter on GitHub.

1.2.0: Icon Management Evolved

Important Note: This release introduces significant improvements to how Thaw manages menu bar item positions. Your icon positions are now automatically saved and restored across app restarts. If you experience any issues with icon positioning, use the new "Reset Thaw" button in Advanced Settings to restore default settings.

New Features:

  • Icon Position Persistence: Thaw now remembers where your icons belong! Menu bar items are automatically restored to their saved sections (visible, hidden, or always-hidden) after app restarts or system reboots. No more manually re-sorting icons after logging in.
  • Custom Menu Bar Item Names: You can now rename any menu bar item with a custom name of your choice. Perfect for giving cryptic icons a more descriptive label or organizing your workflow.
  • Menu Bar Item Tooltips: Enable optional tooltips that appear when hovering over items in the actual menu bar. Know exactly what each icon represents without clicking.
  • URL Scheme Support: External tools like Raycast can now control Thaw via the thaw:// URL scheme. Toggle the Thaw Bar, show or hide sections, and more using custom commands.
  • Manual Application Menu Toggle: Added a configurable hotkey to manually toggle application menu visibility. Useful for presentations or when you need the full menu bar width temporarily.
  • Thaw Bar Hover Highlight: Items in the Thaw Bar now show a subtle background highlight when hovered, making it easier to identify which item you're about to interact with.
  • Conflicting Apps Detection: Thaw now detects when other menu bar management apps are running and warns you about potential conflicts.
  • Per-Display Settings: Configure "Always show hidden items" and Thaw Bar positioning independently for each connected display. Perfect for multi-monitor setups with different screen sizes or notch configurations.
  • Reset Thaw Button: A new reset button in Advanced Settings allows you to quickly restore all Thaw settings to their defaults when troubleshooting.

Improvements & Fixes:

  • Startup Stability: Fixed the "icon parade" issue where icons would continuously shuffle for 10–15 seconds after login. Thaw now enters a settling period during startup to prevent premature rearrangement.
  • Multi-Icon App Support: Apps with multiple menu bar icons (such as Stats, Hammerspoon, and iStat Menus) now stay properly organized in their designated sections instead of gradually migrating to the visible menu bar over time.
  • Memory Optimizations: Reduced memory usage by skipping wallpaper captures when not needed, clearing stale caches when displays disconnect, and adding proper cleanup for background tasks.
  • Performance: Throttled mouse event handling and optimized image caching to reduce CPU usage and improve overall responsiveness.
  • Privacy: Added screen recording permission checks for tooltips and search features. These options are now hidden in settings when permissions are not granted.
  • Visual Refinements: Improved IceBar item highlight sizing with better corner radius and padding for a more modern appearance that matches macOS design language.
  • Same-Icon Differentiation: Fixed a bug where different apps sharing the same icon were conflated. Thaw now correctly identifies items by their source application.
  • Auto-Rehide Reliability: Improved the rehide logic to prevent items from staying visible longer than intended, and fixed cases where manual hide states could get stuck.

Localization:

Thaw now supports 17 languages with 100% completion! A huge thank you to our community contributors:

  • Bahasa Indonesia: by @volcbs
  • Čeština (Czech): new in this release
  • Deutsch: by @Mutzki13

  • Nederlands (Dutch): by @SeBr28
  • Polski (Polish): new in this release

  • 正體中文 (Chinese Traditional): by @7a6163

Thank you to everyone who tested the beta versions and provided feedback that made this release possible!

item.title: 1.2.0-rc.4
item.description:
1.2.0-rc.4: Localization Refinement & Stability Improvements

  • Internationalization Updates:
    • Finalized Czech (CS) language updates for the 1.2.0 release cycle.
    • Updated Turkish (TR) translations.
  • Fixes:
    • Reverted "Robust Icon Position Handling" to address regression issues and maintain system stability while the feature is further refined.

1.1.0: Breaking the Ice

⚠️ Important Note: Due to essential internal changes in how Thaw manages menu bar items, your current icon positions will be reset to "Always Visible." I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but this manual re-adjustment is unavoidable to ensure future stability.

Localization Support:

Thaw is now available in 12 languages with 100% completion. A huge thank you to our community contributors:

  • Chinese (Simplified): by @PiCpo
  • Chinese (Traditional): by @7a6163
  • Dutch: by @SeBr28
  • French: by @PipaCode
  • German: by @Mutzki13
  • Hungarian: by @johnnybakucz
  • Indonesian: by @volcbs
  • Italian: by @zichichi
  • Korean: by @YuriHan
  • Spanish: by @diazdesandi
  • Thai: by @priesdelly

Changes and Fixes:

  • Multi-Monitor Support: Improved app menu hiding logic to correctly account for screen edges and active menu bars across multiple monitors.
  • Ultra-wide Monitor Fix: Resolved an issue where menu bar items were incorrectly included in calculations, which previously caused "Hidden" and Always Hidden" items to appear incorrectly on the left side of ultra-wide screens.
  • Refined Notch Detection: Implemented auxiliaryTopLeftArea for more accurate notch detection and added an option to enable the IceBar only on displays with a notch.
  • Immediate UI Updates: Menubar shapes (split/full) now update instantly when settings are changed, eliminating the previous 30-second delay.
  • Display-Specific Layouts: Fixed an issue where menu bar items from primary displays were incorrectly included in trailing path calculations for external monitors.
  • Performance Optimizations: Reduced CPU usage by debouncing image cache updates, adding polling delays, and skipping background timer tasks when panels are hidden.
  • Simplified Settings: Removed the redundant "temporary item delay" setting as the smart rehide logic now handles these cases automatically.
  • Thaw Bar Scaling Fix: Resolved a scaling issue in the Thaw Bar by clamping the menu bar content height and capping item height to ensure consistent rendering.
  • New Interaction: Added the ability to double-click directly on the menu bar to reveal the "Always Hidden" section.

1.0.0: The Official Release

Thaw has reached its first stable milestone! This release consolidates all the progress from the beta period into a polished, reliable menu bar manager.

Latest Improvements (since beta 4):

  • Enhanced Reliability: Stabilized HIDEventManager logic to prevent "show on hover" and "show on click" from stopping after repeated use and prevent saving chevron divider position which could leave Thaw in an unusable state.
  • UI Polish: Condensed the menu bar tooltip for a cleaner look and added explicit double-click instructions.
  • System Safety: Improved thread safety by synchronizing access to the cursor hide count.
  • Apple Menu Fix: Refined synthetic press offsets to ensure Thaw never accidentally triggers the Apple menu.

Highlights from the Journey to 1.0:

  • The Big Thaw: Successfully forked and rebranded with a new identity, app icon, and independent bundle ID (com.stonerl.Thaw).
  • Ice Migration: Built-in support to import your old settings and control item positions from Ice.
  • Advanced Control: Introduced "Double-Click to Reveal" for always-hidden items and "Smart Rehide" strategies.
  • Modern macOS Support: Optimized for stability on macOS 26.
  • Performance: Faster icon caching, display-aware state refreshing, and thread-safe operations.

Known Issues:

If you are currently on macOS 14 or 15, please be aware that Thaw currently has some known bugs regarding temporary icons in the floating Thaw bar.

I am actively investigating these issues and will release a fix as soon as possible. You can track the progress of this issue here: GitHub Issue #1.

Thank you for all the feedback during the beta period that made this release possible!
